purpose: Preserve the original frozen biomedical positive-event manifest as historical provenance while recording stronger or conflicting source evidence discovered later during an outcome-blind GCAT source cross-validation branch.

immutable_parent.note: The parent manifest used 1949-12-12 for Albert IV and 1952-05-22 for Patricia/Mike because those dates were frozen from the then-used NASA public history source before GCAT was inspected. This corrective audit does not alter those historical bytes.

pre_frozen_crossvalidation_gate.required: 6/6 exact civil-date plus vehicle-family matches against the historical frozen official JANUS controls
pre_frozen_crossvalidation_gate.reason: Later provenance evidence may correct source dates for future work, but may not rewrite the pre-frozen criterion after GCAT outcomes were seen.

events.location: White Sands Proving Ground / White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico

evidence.specificity: Directly identifies the fourth animal experiment as V-2 #31 on 8 December 1949 and names Albert IV.
GCAT rcat identifies Albert IV / V-2 No.31 and launch chronology places the matching V-2 flight on 8 December 1949.

evidence.authority: NASA public animal-space history lineage used by the historical parent manifest
evidence.specificity: Modern public-history summary date retained as a documented conflicting source, not silently erased.
Targeted tokens for both disputed dates and Albert IV identity were absent from the fragmented NTRS text extraction; this extraction therefore did not adjudicate the conflict.

events.future_analysis_rule: When a future analysis explicitly binds this corrective audit, use 1949-12-08 as the event date. Historical results generated from the immutable parent remain historical and must not be silently recomputed or relabeled.

events.vehicle_identity: Aerobee RTV-A-1 / USAF 26 / Aeromed 3 / Patricia and Mike with two mice
events.location: Holloman Air Force Base / Holloman Air Development Center, New Mexico

evidence.specificity: Quotes a document stating five V-2 and three Aerobee animal flights were accomplished between 16 June 1948 and 21 May 1952, with total success and survival of two monkeys and two mice in the last flights.

evidence.authority: National Museum of the United States Air Force
evidence.specificity: USAF photo metadata identifies an Aerobee launch team with a typical experiment package at Holloman AFB on 21 May 1952. The photo caption does not itself name Patricia/Mike, so it is supporting timing evidence rather than unique payload identity proof.
Matching biological Holloman row: Aerobee RTV-A-1, USAF 26, Aeromed 3, HADC launch site, biology category.

evidence.authority: National Museum of the United States Air Force
evidence.specificity: Fact sheet directly names Patricia and Mike and dates their Aerobee flight to 22 May 1952.
Targeted 21/22 May, USAF 26, Aeromed 3 and Patricia/Mike tokens were absent from the fragmented NTRS text extraction; this extraction did not adjudicate the date conflict.

events.future_analysis_rule: Do not silently replace the historical parent date. For a new source-aware event manifest, 1952-05-21 may be used only with an explicit PREFERRED_SOURCE_DATE_UNDER_OPEN_CONFLICT label until an identified contemporaneous flight/telemetry/mission report resolves the one-day disagreement. Sensitivity should preserve 1952-05-22 as the conflicting official-public-history date where timing matters.

next_gate: Identify a contemporaneous or near-contemporaneous Holloman/Aero-Medical Laboratory mission, telemetry, range, or launch report for USAF 26 / Aeromed 3 to resolve 1952-05-21 versus 1952-05-22.
If such a report is found, create a new append-only date-resolution artifact; do not mutate this audit or the historical parent manifest.
Do not reopen JPFM-4B solely because source dates were corrected; a row-complete or otherwise explicitly scoped event manifest still requires its own preregistration and admission gate.
